response.description:
Starting October 1, 2026, the specified runtime versions Python 2.7, Python 3.8, and PowerShell 7.1 & 7.2. will
no longer be supported by Automation.  Runbooks
using these versions may continue to run but will not receive security updates,
bug fixes, or official support.Recommended action: To
minimize security risks and take advantage of the latest features and
improvements, it is strongly recommended upgrading your runbooks to supported
runtime versions of Python and PowerShell.  You
can refer to the following support lifecycle resources for guidance and upgrade
to latest versions  
 PowerShell Support Lifecycle  
 Python Version Support Status  Upgrading
is required to maintain support eligibility and ensure continued access to
security updates and platform features. Learn
more.
response.title: Retirement: Support for Python-2.7; 3.8 and PowerShell- 7.1; 7.2 will be retired on September 30, 2026
